mr_briney.what: MR. BRINEY, the old sailor (his cottage on ROUTE 104; the same figure stands at the DEWFORD and SLATEPORT landings)

mr_stone.what: MR. STONE, the DEVON president, at his desk on the 3rd floor

old_rod_fisherman.what: the DEWFORD fisherman who gives the OLD ROD

steven.what: STEVEN, in his room at the back of GRANITE CAVE

milestones.title: RUSTBORO CITY: the DEVON employee is robbed by a TEAM AQUA GRUNT

hint.said: Get out! Out of the way! Wait! Pleeeaaase! Don't take my GOODS!

milestones.note: automatic scene: RustboroCity_EventScript_StolenGoodsTrigger0-4 are COORD events on x=23, y=20..24 while VAR_RUSTBORO_CITY_STATE==1, and that var is set to 1 by ROXANNE's defeat script (RustboroCity_Gym/scripts.inc), so the scene plays on the first walk out of the gym past those tiles. FLAG_DEVON_GOODS_STOLEN is set here but CLEARED again in RusturfTunnel when the goods are recovered, so it is NOT used as a proof (it would flip back); the two vars only move up

milestones.title: The DEVON employee asks for help getting the DEVON GOODS back

hint.said: Oh, it's you! You're that fantastic TRAINER who helped me in PETALBURG WOODS! Help me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA! I have to get the DEVON GOODS back! If I don't… I'm going to be in serious trouble.

milestones.note: optional: the HelpGetGoodsTrigger0-3 coord events (x=29..30, y=9..12, state 2) play it on the walk east toward ROUTE 116, but RusturfTunnel sets the state to 4 whether or not it played, so it never gates anything

milestones.title: RUSTURF TUNNEL: beat the TEAM AQUA GRUNT and take back the DEVON GOODS

hint.said: That shady character, I think he took off towards the tunnel over there.

milestones.note: the tunnel entrance is the ROUTE 116 warp; the GRUNT (with PEEKO) stands at (13,5) while VAR_RUSTURF_TUNNEL_STATE==2 and backs up at the AquaGruntBackUp coord tiles (state 3). Scripted fight (RusturfTunnel_EventScript_Grunt: trainerbattle_no_intro): ONE POOCHYENA Lv 11. (The earlier CH5-REPORT's 'lvl16 GEODUDE, GEODUDE, MACHOP' is MIKE_2, the optional HIKER in the same tunnel, not the grunt.) The tunnel's far (Verdanturf) side needs ROCK SMASH and is not part of this milestone

milestones.title: Return the DEVON GOODS to the DEVON employee

hint.said: Oh, it's you! You're that fantastic TRAINER who helped me in PETALBURG WOODS! Help me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA! I have to get the DEVON GOODS back! If I don't… I'm going to be in serious trouble.

milestones.note: no line of dialogue tells the player to bring the goods back: the employee's ReturnGoodsTrigger0-3 coord events (x=30..31, y=9..12, state 4) and a talk to him (RustboroCity_EventScript_DevonEmployee1 when FLAG_RECOVERED_DEVON_GOODS) start RustboroCity_EventScript_ReturnGoods, which gives a GREAT BALL and warps the player to DEVON CORP 3F

milestones.title: DEVON CORP 3F: MR. STONE's favor (the LETTER for STEVEN) and the POKéNAV

hint.said: Our PRESIDENT would like to have a word with you. Please come with me.

milestones.note: automatic (RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_EventScript_MeetPresident, an OnFrame script at VAR_DEVON_CORP_3F_STATE==0, runs on arrival from the ReturnGoods warp): the player follows the employee, receives ITEM_LETTER (giveitem, no flag of its own) and the POKéNAV, and the party is healed. The script itself is the only place these four are set

milestones.title: Leaving DEVON CORP: the scientist adds MATCH CALL and the player must open the POKéNAV from the START menu
milestones.note: INTERACTIVE, not a cut scene: RustboroCity_EventScript_ScientistAddMatchCall runs from the OnFrame table at VAR_RUSTBORO_CITY_STATE==6 and ends in RustboroCity_EventScript_MatchCallTutorial, which opens a START menu where only the POKéNAV entry is accepted (every other choice loops back to 'Please select POKéNAV'); only after it does the script set VAR_RUSTBORO_CITY_STATE to 7 (RustboroCity/scripts.inc:88). This is the first step in the game that needs the AI to pick a START-menu entry

milestones.title: South RUSTBORO: the rival (MAY or BRENDAN) meets the player and mentions MR. BRINEY

hint.said: MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS. I guess he's on his way home to his cottage by the sea. How's your POKéDEX coming along, {PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent! So… How about a little battle?

milestones.note: RivalTrigger0-7 are COORD events on y=53, x=12..19 while VAR_RUSTBORO_CITY_STATE==7 (state 7 is set in RustboroCity/scripts.inc on the way out of DEVON CORP). The rival also has a SECOND chance on ROUTE 104 (Route104_EventScript_RivalTrigger at (17,51), VAR_ROUTE104_STATE==1) which sets state 8 and runs the same RustboroCity_EventScript_RivalEncounter. The hint quoted is the MAY (male player) text; the BRENDAN (female player) text carries the same 'cottage' words, checked by this generator

milestones.title: The rival's battle outside RUSTBORO (declinable)

hint.said: MAY: So, what do you think? How about a little battle here?

milestones.note: OPTIONAL because the battle is a YES/NO prompt (RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle / ...MayOhHaventRaisedPokemonEnough on NO) and the rival leaves once the player sails (Route104_MrBrineysHouse sets FLAG_HIDE_RUSTBORO_CITY_RIVAL), so it can be skipped for good. The SAME flag is set by all six variants (the trainer is chosen by the player's gender and VAR_STARTER_MON), which is why the proof is the flag, not a trainer; per_trainer lists all six. Rewards: none

milestones.title: ROUTE 104: MR. BRINEY's cottage (he offers to sail to DEWFORD)

hint.said: MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS. I guess he's on his way home to his cottage by the sea. How's your POKéDEX coming along, {PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent! So… How about a little battle?

milestones.note: FLAG_MR_BRINEY_SAILING_INTRO is set the FIRST time the player talks to MR. BRINEY, BEFORE the yes/no (Route104_MrBrineysHouse_EventScript_SailingIntro), so it proves 'talked to him', not 'sailed'. Sailing itself leaves no durable flag of its own: VAR_BOARD_BRINEY_BOAT_STATE is 1 only during the voyage and Route104_EventScript_SailToDewford resets it to 0 on landing (Route104/scripts.inc:394), so the arrival proof is the next milestone's VISITED_DEWFORD_TOWN

milestones.title: Sail with MR. BRINEY to DEWFORD TOWN

hint.said: I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of the DEVON CORPORATION. I'd just got word about you! You saved our staff not just once, but twice! I have a favor to ask of an amazing person like you. I understand that you're delivering a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD. Well, on the way, could you stop off in DEWFORD TOWN? I was hoping that you'd deliver a LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.

milestones.note: set by DewfordTown_OnTransition on every arrival (map load), so it is the durable proof of having landed. Boat only: the voyage starts on Route104_MrBrineysHouse_EventScript_SailToDewford (answer YES) and the player is warped to ROUTE 104 (13,51) where Route104_OnFrame runs the sail

milestones.title: DEWFORD TOWN: the fisherman's OLD ROD

hint.said: This is a renowned fishing spot. Are you getting the itch to fish?

milestones.note: optional gift (answer YES to 'Are you getting the itch to fish?'); gates nothing in chapters 5-8

milestones.title: GRANITE CAVE: deliver MR. STONE's LETTER to STEVEN

hint.said: I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of the DEVON CORPORATION. I'd just got word about you! You saved our staff not just once, but twice! I have a favor to ask of an amazing person like you. I understand that you're delivering a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD. Well, on the way, could you stop off in DEWFORD TOWN? I was hoping that you'd deliver a LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.

milestones.note: NO line of dialogue names GRANITE CAVE: MR. STONE says 'STEVEN in DEWFORD', MR. BRINEY 'who was it now, STEVEN', and the HIKER inside the cave 'that guy who came by earlier... STEVEN'. The cave mouth is on ROUTE 106 (GRANITE_CAVE_1F warp (37,12)); STEVEN's door is the (5,10) warp on 1F and 1F's warps to B1F (a dark map, maps.json requires_flash) lead to it, so the way to his room goes through the dark B1F. Darkness shrinks the view; FLASH needs BADGE02. Whether B1F can be crossed unlit was NOT run: marked uncertain in the report. Steven hands over TM STEEL WING in the same script

milestones.title: GRANITE CAVE 1F: the HIKER's HM FLASH

hint.said: Hey, you. It gets awfully dark ahead. It'll be tough trying to explore. That guy who came by earlier… STEVEN, I think it was. He knew how to use FLASH, so he ought to be all right, but… Well, for us HIKERS, helping out those that we meet is our motto. Here you go, I'll pass this on to you.

milestones.note: optional gift. Using FLASH outside battle needs BADGE02 (src/party_menu.c, FIELD_MOVE_FLASH), i.e. Brawly first

milestones.title: The DEWFORD GYM's trainers

hint.said: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: BRAWLY “A big wave in fighting!”

milestones.note: optional (DewfordTown_Gym_EventScript_CountTrainersDefeated lights the dark room by the number beaten; BRAWLY can be fought without them)

milestones.title: BRAWLY: the KNUCKLE BADGE

hint.said: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM LEADER: BRAWLY “A big wave in fighting!”

milestones.note: BRAWLY is a trainerbattle_single with an on-defeat script (DewfordTown_Gym_EventScript_BrawlyDefeated) that sets both flags, then gives TM BULK UP. The TM's FLAG_RECEIVED_TM_BULK_UP is set in TWO places (GiveBulkUp and GiveBulkUp2, both in DewfordTown_Gym) and is skipped when the bag is full, so it is not a proof. The hint is the GYM SIGN ('LEADER: BRAWLY'); MR. STONE and the HIKER name only 'DEWFORD'S POKéMON GYM'

milestones.title: Back in RUSTBORO: MR. STONE thanks the player for the LETTER (EXP. SHARE)

hint.said: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!

milestones.note: optional: needs FLAG_DELIVERED_STEVEN_LETTER, then a trip back to RUSTBORO (boat to PETALBURG, walk), talking to MR. STONE (RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_EventScript_GiveExpShare)
